_meta.extraction_method: gunzip'd the .als (gzip-compressed XML), parsed <Locator><Time Value=.../><Name Value=.../></Locator> elements directly, converted beat-time to bar number at each project's own tempo
_meta.status: specification/reference only - not consumed by any code yet. No song-level arrangement generator exists (current DrumEngine/BassEngine each produce one fixed-length Drop section only).

section_length_stats.note: every observed section length is a multiple of 8 except one 4-bar Pre-Break micro-transition

state_machine.typical_sequence: INTRO -> FULL_GROOVE -> DROP -> ELEMENT_REINTRODUCTION -> PRE_BREAK -> BREAK -> BUILD -> DROP -> [MELODIC_BREAK_SHORT_VARIANT ->] DROP -> OUTRO
state_machine.note: not a rigid mandatory template - the 3 reference tracks vary in exact order/count; PRE_BREAK and ELEMENT_REINTRODUCTION are the two states most guides/generic templates omit but all 3 real tracks include
state_machine.explicitly_not_this: the generic-EDM Pop Form (Intro/Verse/Pre-Chorus/Chorus/Bridge/Drop/Outro) - a real, different, named structure per the same source PDF

pml_guide_melodic_techno_structure.note: these are the PDF's own generic per-genre-guideline ranges, expressed as running bar counts from track start, not per-section lengths - kept separate from the 3 real tracks' actual authored section lengths above since the two don't use identical bar-numbering conventions

drop_types.name: Fancy Drop
drop_types.description: deliberately different from everything before - new sound design elements, high impact

breakdown_design.layton_giordani_technique: low-pass filter automation on the bassline during breakdowns/build-ups, to create tension and anticipation - the single most consistently attributed concrete technique across sources
tension_techniques: gradual high-pass filter sweep, 20Hz->200-400Hz over 16-32 bars
delayed snare fills / randomized rhythmic elements
reversed pads through long reverb tails
removing lead synths right before impact

build_design.note: builds are NOT a fixed length - they depend on which drop they lead into; later-drop builds are consistently much shorter than the initial build in all 3 reference tracks
